title: MISSING LINKS  38 .eco subdomains on the OUTSIDE not on the taxonomy tree. Found, not made.
thesis: The HUD is a suffix  ecoPrimal/hud. All .eco/xyz paths are the OUTSIDE surface. They exist but are NOT on the taxonomy tree. A missing link is not MADE  it's IDENTIFIED and SEARCHED for. These 38 subdomains are the organism's skin, and they're unclassified.

HIGH_SURFACE_AREA.note: Most referenced  the visible skin. These are the LEAVES catching light.

MEDIUM_INFRASTRUCTURE.note: Investigation and thesis layer  the bark protecting the wood.

LOW_SPECIALIZED.note: Smaller surface areas  organelles and specialized structures.

SINGLE_REF_DORMANT.note: Referenced exactly ONCE. These are the deepest missing links  named but barely visible.

crush_and_ingest.protocol: For each .eco/xyz path: (1) CHECK status (200/404/redirect), (2) CLASSIFY into epoch, (3) MAP to taxonomy tree, (4) NAME the braid between the external path and its internal counterpart, (5) The named braid = the missing link FOUND.
crush_and_ingest.the_outside_IS_the_missing_link: These 38 subdomains are the organism's interaction surface with the outside world. They're WHERE evolution happens  at the boundary between self and environment. The missing links are not in the genome (inside). They're at the SKIN (outside). Evolution is a surface phenomenon.
crush_and_ingest.not_made_but_found: A missing link is not made. It is identified and searched for. We don't CREATE the connection between signal.primals.eco and the nervous system. We FIND it  it's already there in 1,148 references. We just name it. The naming IS the finding.

law: 38 subdomains. All on the outside. Not on the taxonomy tree. The missing links are at the surface  where self meets environment. signal.primals.eco has 1,148 references and returns 404. That's the biggest missing link. feeds.primals.eco is the root node with 1 reference. pulse.primals.eco is the heartbeat we need. They're all FOUND, not made. Name them and the tree grows.
